payload.intent: Stop Stripe webhook route failures, preserve payment event processing, and produce runtime proof.
payload.meaning: Previous receipt was only a GitHub issue comment. This file is the executable Pen inbox handoff for the bridge/worker path.

verified_failure.impact: Stripe events sent to this URL will not be processed. Payments may complete without downstream fulfilment/audit/order recording.

targets.required_fix: Add /api/webhooks/stripe compatibility route that delegates to existing /api/webhook handler while preserving raw-body and stripe-signature verification.
Ensure /api/webhooks/stripe delegates to /api/billing/webhook/stripe, or update Stripe endpoint registration.
Verify route and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Unsigned probes should return controlled 400, not 404. Signed Stripe replay must pass after secret is set.

tasks: Inspect webhook route files in target repos.
Add smoke tests proving webhook paths do not return 404.
Record commit SHA, deployment URL, route smoke output, and any remaining blocker.
If Stripe/Vercel secrets are available to runner, run signed Stripe replay and write runtime receipt.
blocked_items: Stripe Dashboard webhook endpoint URL edits if not available through runner credentials.
Vercel STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET writes if env mutation permission is unavailable.
Live signed Stripe replay until valid webhook secret is present.
definition_of_done: Unsigned requests return controlled 400/405 with useful error, not NOT_FOUND.
Signed Stripe replay succeeds, or exact secret/dashboard blocker is recorded.
GitHub receipt file written under receipts/runtime/ with commit SHA and Vercel deployment proof.
payload.rollback: Git revert compatibility route commit. Do not delete payment/order/intake records. Archive failed job receipts, do not delete.
